2: const KEYS = [
3:   'KeyW', 'KeyA', 'KeyS', 'KeyD',
4:   'ShiftLeft', 'Space',
5:   'KeyP', 'KeyM',
6:   'Digit1', 'Digit2', 'Digit3', 'Digit4',
7:   'KeyE',
8:   'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight',
9: ];
10: 
11: class Input {
12:   constructor(canvas) {
13:     this._keys = {};
14:     this._justPressed = new Set();
15:     this._locked = false;
16:     this._yaw = 0;
17:     this._pitch = 0;
18:     this._sensitivity = 0.002;
19:     this._lastMouseX = 0;
20:     this._lastMouseY = 0;
21: 
22:     this._initKeyboard();
23:     this._initPointer();
24:   }
25: 
26:   _initKeyboard() {
27:     document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
28:       if (KEYS.includes(e.code)) {
29:         this._keys[e.code] = true;
30:         this._justPressed.add(e.code);
31:       }
32:       e.preventDefault();
33:     });
34:     document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
35:       if (KEYS.includes(e.code)) {
36:         this._keys[e.code] = false;
37:       }
38:     });
39:   }
40: 
41:   _initPointer() {
42:     const canvasEl = document.querySelector('canvas');
43:     canvasEl.addEventListener('click', () => {
44:       if (!this._locked) {
45:         canvasEl.requestPointerLock();
46:       }
47:     });
48: 
49:     document.addEventListener('pointerlockchange', () => {
50:       this._locked = document.pointerLockElement === canvasEl;
51:     });
52: 
53:     document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
54:       if (!this._locked) return;
55:       this._yaw -= e.movementX * this._sensitivity;
56:       this._pitch -= e.movementY * this._sensitivity;
57:       this._pitch = Math.max(-Math.PI / 2, Math.min(Math.PI / 2, this._pitch));
58:       // WHY: rotação positiva mantém movimento alinhado à câmera
59:       this._yaw = (this._yaw + Math.PI) % (2 * Math.PI) - Math.PI;
60:     });
61:   }
62: 
63:   isDown(code) {
64:     return this._keys[code] === true;
65:   }
66: 
67:   consume(code) {
68:     this._justPressed.delete(code);
69:   }
70: 
71:   getAxis() {
72:     let x = 0, z = 0;
73:     if (this.isDown('KeyW')) z -= 1;
74:     if (this.isDown('KeyS')) z += 1;
75:     if (this.isDown('KeyA')) x -= 1;
76:     if (this.isDown('KeyD')) x += 1;
77:     if (this.isDown('ArrowUp')) z -= 1;
78:     if (this.isDown('ArrowDown')) z += 1;
79:     if (this.isDown('ArrowLeft')) x -= 1;
80:     if (this.isDown('ArrowRight')) x += 1;
81:     const len = Math.sqrt(x * x + z * z);
82:     if (len > 0) { x /= len; z /= len; }
83:     return { x, z };
84:   }
85: 
86:   get yaw() { return this._yaw; }
87:   get pitch() { return this._pitch; }
88:   get locked() { return this._locked; }
89: 
90:   lock() {
91:     if (!this._locked) {
92:       const canvasEl = document.querySelector('canvas');
93:       canvasEl.requestPointerLock();
94:     }
95:   }
96: 
97:   unlock() {
98:     if (this._locked) {
99:       document.exitPointerLock();
100:     }
101:   }
102: 
103:   get justPressed() { return this._justPressed; }

1: // js/engine.js — Three.js scene setup (renderer, camera, fog, lights)
2: import * as THREE from '../vendor/three.module.js';
3: import C from './constants.js';
4: 
5: const createEngine = (canvas) => {
6:   const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
7:     canvas,
8:     antialias: false,
9:   });
10:   renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 1.5));
11:   renderer.autoClear = true;
12: 
13:   const scene = new THREE.Scene();
14:   scene.background = new THREE.Color(C.RENDER.background);
15:   scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(
16:     C.RENDER.background,
17:     C.RENDER.fogNear,
18:     C.RENDER.fogFar
19:   );
20: 
21:   const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
22:     75,
23:     canvas.clientWidth / canvas.clientHeight,
24:     0.1,
25:     120
26:   );
27:   camera.position.set(0, C.PLAYER.height, 0);
28: 
29:   const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(
30:     C.LIGHT.hemiSky,
31:     C.LIGHT.hemiGround,
32:     C.LIGHT.hemiIntensity
33:   );
34:   hemi.position.set(0, 50, 0);
35: 
36:   const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(C.LIGHT.ambient, 1.0);
37: 
38:   const world = new THREE.Group();
39:   scene.add(hemi);
40:   scene.add(ambient);
41:   scene.add(world);
42: 
43:   const resize = () => {
44:     const w = canvas.clientWidth;
45:     const h = canvas.clientHeight;
46:     camera.aspect = w / h;
47:     camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
48:     renderer.setSize(w, h);
49:   };
50: 
51:   // Loop helper com fixed-step e interpolação alpha
52:   const STEP = C.PHYSICS.step;
53:   const createLoop = (updateFn, renderFn) => {
54:     let accumulator = 0;
55:     let lastTime = performance.now();
56:     const loop = (now) => {
57:       const rawDt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
58:       lastTime = now;
59:       const dt = Math.min(rawDt, 0.016);
60:       accumulator += dt;
61:       while (accumulator >= STEP) {
62:         updateFn(STEP);
63:         accumulator -= STEP;
64:       }
65:       if (renderFn) renderFn(accumulator / STEP);
66:       window.__debugStats = window.__debugStats || { calls: 0 };
67:       window.__debugStats.calls++;
68:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
69:     };
70:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
71:     return { resize, render };
72:   };
73: 
74:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
75: 
76:   return { renderer, scene, camera, world, lights: { hemi, ambient, torches: [] }, resize, createLoop };
77: };
78: 
79: export { createEngine };
